reviews_captured_by_me.text:
I had a great experience with LMG Remodeling. Armando and his crew removed my shutters, which had become very faded from years of sun exposure. They carefully took them down, thoroughly washed them, repainted them, and reinstalled them. The shutters now look like new, and they’re actually more secure than they were originally.

Armando was excellent to work with throughout the entire process. He communicated clearly, worked quickly, and made suggestions that really improved the final result. On top of that, his pricing was very fair for the quality of work provided.

I would highly recommend LMG Remodeling to anyone who needs repairs or improvements done around their home. Professional, reliable, and great workmanship.

LMG did a great job finishing the drywall in our basement! We had hung the drywall ourselves and it was less than perfect. Armando and his team did the corner bead, taping, mudding, sanding and priming and made it look perfect! Fair price, good communication and quality results. They were very considerate of our home and left it cleaner than they found it.

LMG remodeling replaced a gable vent, as well as fence posts and rails on my split rail fence. They were terrific to work with. Their communication was prompt and they kept me informed throughout. They are pleasant people and their conduct is professional. And their prices were very fair. They will certainly be my go to for projects at home
